ጽሑፍ: ጽሑፍ — written; a writing (passive participle, noun)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')

ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')

ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
ይከውኑ: ኮነ — they will be (3mp imperfect, G, k-w-n)
ያን: ፈላሲ — -ያን, the plural ending of ፈላሲ, printed apart from it (ፈላሲ ያን for ፈላስያን 'pilgrims'; sic) (?)
ወፈላስያን: ፈላሲ — and ascetics, hermits (ወ- + plural ፈላስያን; ፈላሲ 'one who goes into exile, wanderer')
ለክልኤሆሙ: ክልኤቱ — to the two of them, to both (ለ- + numeral 'two' + -ሆሙ '3mp them')
